BWA.note: Government of Botswana Enterprise Architecture is named as a financed project, not as published or adopted; no core system is described.

facts.fact: Minister Segokgo told Parliament that implementation of the National Cybersecurity Strategy was continuing.

BWA.note: A cybersecurity law is only to be drafted; no bill or law is stated.
The Digital Delta Data Centre is not stated to rent to other organisations.

facts.fact: The minister said a sovereign cloud infrastructure to be called GovCloud would be implemented, and that critical government services were being migrated to the Digital Delta Data Centre.
The minister presented 2024/25 ministry budget proposals of P2,705,766,587, of which the ICT programme takes P736,601,447 (42.62 percent of the development budget).
facts.system: Ministry of Communications, Knowledge and Technology budget 2024/25

BWA.note: The Online Services project is named as financed only; no portal or service is stated launched.

facts.fact: The minister referred to the existing national backbone network, which has aged, and said segments would be upgraded to give 45 major villages reliable high-speed internet.
The minister said seven new optical fibre links would be implemented in 2024/25 by BoFiNet; the Sebina-Nshakashokwe-Tutume link was complete and Takatokwane-Morwamosu was due that month.

BWA.note: The self-service SIM Card Registration System is not stated to check against the national ID.
No local government connection is stated.
No mobile data price or share of income is stated.
BoFiNet's ownership of Digital Delta is stated, but not that it is national or for hire.
Fibre to police stations is connectivity only; no station record system is stated.
No rural electricity access figure is stated.
